profile.headline: Senior Fullstack .NET Engineer | Xamarin/.NET MAUI & Angular | Delivering High-Performance Mobile & Web Solutions
profile.summary: With a strong foundation in computer science from Tecnológico Nacional de Mexico Campus San Juan del Río, with 8+ years of experience, I have cultivated a diverse career in software development, spanning over 8 years. My professional journey includes hands on experience with .NET and Xamarin technologies across various roles, including Senior Xamarin Developer. Recently, I’ve expanded my expertise into modern web development by working extensively with Angular to build scalable front-end applications using frameworks like NgRx and GraphQL. This blend of mobile and web technology experience enables me to deliver high-quality and efficient solutions for dynamic projects.
